# OneGlanse

> Free, open-source AI visibility tracking for marketing teams.

OneGlanse opens the ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overview websites in a browser and saves the answers and citations it sees. It does not use their model APIs to fetch those answers. A separate model the user configures analyzes the saved text.
